scope: Offline inspection of an embedded FDT in the signature-verified stock 02.01.01.07 U-Boot payload; no firmware executed or hardware measured

kernel.container: Android boot image; 2048-byte pages; 3972872-byte kernel member
kernel.qualification: Image string only; not the owner's running uname result

reproduction: Locate the FDT at the pinned offset, validate its big-endian header and size, walk FDT_BEGIN_NODE/FDT_PROP/FDT_END_NODE tokens, resolve property-name strings and referenced phandles. Read-only parsing; no boot/update execution.
interpretation_limits: An embedded FDT is not proof of the live bootloader-patched kernel device tree or final command line.
Hardware UART0 naming and Linux ttyS2 cannot be equated from these records alone.
PF/PFO supply references do not independently establish the physical UART header signal voltage or RX tolerance.
Do not change boot arguments to reconcile the names or choose a fixed-voltage adapter from these values alone.
A normal receive-only boot capture and verified header/signal levels remain required before transmitting.
